interpretation_notes: Loaded Citeseer via torch_geometric.datasets.Planetoid with NormalizeFeatures, trained a 2-layer GCN (hidden=64, dropout=0.5, Adam lr=0.01 wd=5e-4) on the public 120-node train split, model-selected by val accuracy with early stopping, then predicted labels for the 1000-node test mask. GPU used.
